# Expense Reimbursement Policy

All business expenses must be submitted via Expensify within 30 days of the expense date, with
itemized receipts required for any single expense over $25.

Approved categories: client meals (up to $75/person), software subscriptions under $50/month
(manager pre-approval required above that), and conference registration fees.

Reimbursements are processed within 10 business days of manager approval. Personal expenses,
alcohol at non-client events, and first-class airfare are not reimbursable.

Questions: finance@alderbrooksystems.example.
